capture_requests.procedure: Future prerequisite: reach the declared entry and route-source states through separately evidenced steps; no current parked process is assumed. This request itself establishes no route coverage. Once post-match Evening Results is available, Use its Find, Nations & Clubs and manager menu controls only for the three Results-source route IDs. For Training first click the managed club label to Squad, then open Training. Capture each actual source/action/default/menu and Back. Earlier Evening Fixtures-source routes remain unexercised and cannot close from Results. Red News indicator is a separate hit-test unknown. Record unread effects; no sends, accepts, edits or Continue Game.

Future prerequisite: reach the declared entry and route-source states through separately evidenced steps; no current parked process is assumed. This request itself establishes no route coverage. Evening Results to Competition to Stages, then listed defaults/menus; observe direct returns. Do not invoke dim Print or advance world time. Other group selections are finite variants, not new screens by default.

Future prerequisite: reach the declared entry and route-source states through separately evidenced steps; no current parked process is assumed. This request itself establishes no route coverage. Once Evening Results is available, click managed club label to Squad; click captured player row to Profile when needed. Exercise each listed control only at its route source. Half-time match tabs do not cover pre-kickoff sources. Do not Clear Squad, cancel a fixture, edit tactics or issue offers.

Future prerequisite: reach the declared entry and route-source states through separately evidenced steps; no current parked process is assumed. This request itself establishes no route coverage. Exercise one visible bottom Back source at a time, retain before/after and actual target. Profile tab returns are not Back. Do not extrapolate across finance/transfer/history/competition modes.
